name: Research Immersion in Science and Engineering (RISE)
org: University of Florida, Center for Precollegiate Education and Training
what_you_do: A 1 week UF program where you stay on campus. It has lab tests, hands on work, case studies and field trips in science, engineering and tech.
who_can_apply: Students who will be rising 10th graders (apply in spring of 9th grade). Open worldwide; a few spots are set aside for out of state students.
pay_detail: $1,200 program cost plus $25 application fee; need based scholarships
duration: 1 week residential (June 7 to 12 or July 12 to 17 in 2026)
deadline_text: For 2026: applications opened Jan 5 and were due March 25, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply on the CPET online portal. Send a transcript and the recommendations or prompts the page lists.
notes: The application fee is not refundable. Housing is in the cost.
